skill.name: steel-browser
skill.description: Guides agents to use Steel CLI cloud browser sessions for web navigation, scraping, screenshots, PDFs, forms, and session troubleshooting.
skill.summary: Use Steel cloud browsers for reliable remote web automation and extraction.
skill.author: steel-dev

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown command examples, placeholder URLs, or standard Steel authentication guidance. Confirmed risks remain for CAPTCHA and anti-bot automation, webpage capture artifacts, proxy credential exposure, remote credential injection, and browser JavaScript evaluation. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Anti-bot and CAPTCHA workflows can be used without clear authorization.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation and lawful-use language before using CAPTCHA solving, stealth mode, proxy settings, or anti-bot recovery steps.

remediation.issue: Credential features can inject sensitive account data into remote browser sessions.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to use approved secret stores, redact credential values, and request explicit consent before enabling credential namespaces or injection flags.

remediation.issue: Screenshot examples write potentially sensitive artifacts to shared temporary paths.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer workspace-scoped output paths, avoid shared temp directories for authenticated pages, and delete artifacts when they are no longer needed.

remediation.issue: Browser JavaScript evaluation can run arbitrary scripts in authenticated pages.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to run untrusted JavaScript and prefer narrow extraction commands when script execution is not required.

remediation.issue: Proxy credential examples place secrets in command-line URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Document safer proxy credential handling through environment variables or secret stores, and avoid examples with user:pass URLs.

semantic_findings.title: Credential Injection Into Remote Browser Sessions
semantic_findings.description: The documentation describes credential namespaces and credential injection into Steel browser sessions. This can expose account credentials to remote browser infrastructure without explicit consent controls.

semantic_findings.title: Browser JavaScript Evaluation Capability

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The eval command family is explicitly documented and supports several input modes. It is a normal automation feature, but it is risky with untrusted scripts.

content.value_statement: Dynamic websites often fail with simple fetch tools. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use Steel cloud browsers for scraping, navigation, screenshots, PDFs, and sessions.
actual_capabilities: Selects Steel scrape, screenshot, PDF, or browser commands based on the web task.
Starts, reuses, inspects, and stops named Steel browser sessions.
Navigates pages, clicks elements, fills forms, waits for state changes, and extracts page text.
Captures webpage screenshots and PDFs through Steel commands.
Maps legacy agent-browser commands to steel browser commands.
Uses troubleshooting guides for authentication, session reuse, endpoint, and CAPTCHA status issues.
limitations: Requires Steel CLI installation and authentication before commands can run.
Cloud sessions cannot access localhost or private networks unless the user provides reachable infrastructure.
CAPTCHA solving, proxy use, and stealth features may require a paid Steel plan.
The skill does not decide whether a target website permits automation.

use_cases.title: Collect Dynamic Web Data
use_cases.description: Extract page text and structured content from dynamic public websites for comparison or summarization.

use_cases.title: Verify Multi-Step Web Flows
use_cases.description: Drive repeatable browser steps, capture evidence, and inspect page state in remote sessions.

use_cases.title: Debug Remote Browser Sessions
use_cases.description: Check authentication, session reuse, endpoint mode, live view, and stuck session problems.

prompt_templates.title: Scrape a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Steel to extract readable content from this URL and summarize the main points: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Capture Page Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use a named Steel session to open [URL], capture a screenshot, and report the page title.

prompt_templates.title: Automate a Form Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Steel browser commands to open [URL], fill the form fields I provide, and stop the session after verification.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Agent Browser Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this agent-browser workflow to steel browser commands, preserving session behavior and adding validation steps: [workflow].

output_examples.input: Extract product details from a dynamic catalog page.
output_examples.output: A concise summary of product names, prices, availability, and source page notes.

output_examples.input: Capture a PDF of a public policy page.
output_examples.output: A saved PDF artifact, the page title, the final URL, and any access warnings.
A short recovery note that identifies the session mismatch and recommends a fresh named session.

best_practices: Use named sessions for every multi-step workflow.
Stop Steel sessions when the task is complete unless the user asks to keep them running.
Confirm authorization before using credentialed sessions, proxy settings, or CAPTCHA features.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for localhost-only or private network targets that Steel cloud cannot reach.
Do not print API keys, credential values, or raw connect URLs in responses.
Do not run CAPTCHA, proxy, or credential workflows without clear user authorization.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Steel account?
faq.answer: Yes. Steel CLI installation and authentication are required before cloud browser commands can run.

faq.question: Can it browse localhost?
faq.answer: Not through default cloud sessions. Use self-hosted mode or another local tool for private local targets.

faq.question: Can it scrape static pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can route simple extraction tasks to Steel scrape before opening an interactive browser session.

faq.question: Can it handle CAPTCHAs?
faq.answer: It documents Steel CAPTCHA status and solve commands. Use them only with authorization and plan support.

faq.question: Does it store credentials?
faq.answer: The skill references Steel credential namespaces. Credentials should remain in approved secret stores.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
